typographie_suggestion.explanation: The typeface features a strong contrast between thick and thin strokes and vertical stress, characteristic of the 18th-century French printing style (specifically the Didot family, as mentioned in the imprint "Chez P. Franç. Didot"). It marks the transition from the softer Old Style to the high-contrast Modern/Didone style.
